name: insight
description: Samples the live per-pair traffic snapshot and reads the firewall's own gauges: memory, processor, temperature, uptime, load, disk, interface counters, gateways and swap (data source 3).

endpoints.name: traffic_top
endpoints.note: Per interface, a records[] of local addresses with rate_bits_in/out, cumulative_bytes_in/out and a details[] of peers. No port and no protocol. One call runs iftop -s 2 on every interface named, concurrently (scripts/interfaces/traffic_top.py), so no answer is fresher than its 2-second capture: that span is the floor. The floor measured on a live firewall is pending LV-C.

endpoints.name: system_resources
endpoints.note: Memory figures. Field names not established by the survey.

endpoints.name: system_temperature
endpoints.note: Per-sensor temperatures. Absent on hardware with no sensor, which is a state and not a zero.

endpoints.name: system_disk
endpoints.note: Filesystem usage. Field names not established by the survey.

endpoints.name: gateway_status
endpoints.survey_section: Gateway status, read from source for step 5
endpoints.note: Returns {items: [...], status: ok | failed}; each item carries name, address, status, loss, delay and stddev, or ~ where dpinger has no figure.

endpoints.name: system_swap
endpoints.survey_section: Swap, read from source for step 5
endpoints.note: Returns {swap: [{device, total, used}]}, total and used as strings in KiB.

endpoints.name: cpu_usage_stream
endpoints.survey_section: Processor stream, read from source for the resolver-cache cycle
endpoints.note: text/event-stream, one event about every second and no end; read only with a bound.
